raw_segments.text: Richard, sweet prince, the untainted virtue of your years hath not yet dived into the
world's deceit, nor more can you distinguish of a man than of his outward show, which,
God he knows, seldom or never jumpeth with the heart.
Those uncles which you want were dangerous.
Your grace attended to their sugared words, but looked not on the poison of their hearts.
God keep you from them, and from such false friends.
